titulo: Two organisers of Hong Kong's Tiananmen vigils charged for inciting subversion
cuerpo: Two former organisers of Hong Kong’s annual vigils in remembrance of the 1989 Tiananmen Square massacre were convicted for "incitement to subversion". Three government-vetted judges ruled that Lee Cheuk-yan and Chow Hang-tung had "incited other persons to organise, plan, commit or participate in acts by unlawful means with a view to subverting the state power."
